thread:
Liz Chen: FYI — customer Kestrel asked for per-endpoint reservations that auto-convert to overage credits when they exceed a soft cap. They want this per-route so their extraction pipeline doesn't starve search.

Sam Patel: Clarify — hosted API or dedicated?

Alex Rivera: Hosted. They want per-route ceilings with a soft cap that, when hit, either pulls from a prepaid credit pool or starts billing at a negotiated overage rate.

Jonathan Cole: Finance flag — we can offer "convertible credits" but it needs a contractual amendment. Recommend a minimum committed amount (20% of expected monthly tokens) to avoid bill shock.

Maria Gomez: Eng notes — feasible. Implementation: per-route token buckets + a conversion hook that reconciles usage to prepaid credits. Rough ETA: ~2w effort across runtime + billing infra. Need a small config API change. Example config: 

```json
{"route":"/v1/extract","reserved_tokens":200000,"soft_cap":0.8,"convert_on_exceed":true}
```

Liz Chen: Can we expose this in the Console so customers can see reserved vs used tokens and trigger manual conversion?

Sam Patel: UX idea — add a "Reserved capacity" card per route with a toggle for "Auto-convert to credits" and a histogram of consumption.

pricing-bot: ESTIMATE: assuming convert_on_exceed=true and overage rate=$0.0004/token, 1M burst tokens => ~$400 in overage; if converted to prepaid credits at discounted rate, delta could be ~$12k depending on negotiated band (rough ballpark).

Jonathan Cole: Contract language suggestion: label feature "convertible-reserve"; require 14-day notice for conversion parameter changes and a minimum commit. Legal to review SLA carveouts.

Alex Rivera: Customer will likely push for SLA on reserved lane. For hosted we can promise priority routing best-effort; recommend offering Dedicated pool if they need strict SLOs.

Maria Gomez: Fallback behavior proposal: when conversion is in-flight or fails, route falls back to a lower-cost model variant or queuing with priority, not outright reject. That avoids hard outages.

Liz Chen: Action items: Sam -> draft product spec + console mockups; Maria -> design doc + infra cost estimate; Jonathan -> proposed contract clause and pricing table; Alex -> confirm customer appetite for minimum commit and pilot. Target decision by EOD Thu.

Sam Patel: I'll start a PRD stub and link it here when ready.

Alex Rivera: I'll sync with the account team and schedule a customer pilot call.

Liz Chen: :thumbsup: Thanks — ping me if anything blocks.
